tools.name: query
tools.title: Query the Director (read-only)
tools.description: Run a read-only bconsole command on the Director and return its output. Allowed: status, list, llist, show, version, help, time, messages, estimate, and dot-commands such as .jobs, .clients, .pools, .storages, .filesets, .help. Examples: 'status dir', 'list jobs', 'llist jobid=42', 'show fileset=Linux'.

tools.name: ovfs_status
tools.title: Restore-tree backend status
tools.description: Whether the catalog has the OVFS PostgreSQL extension (version) and whether restore trees use it or the Director fallback. Results are the same either way.

tools.name: ovfs_latest
tools.title: Job chain of a client's latest backup
tools.description: JobIds (Full, Differential, Incrementals) that restore the client's latest state, as Bareos restore option 5 selects them. Pass them to ovfs_tree/ovfs_ls.

fileset.description: FileSet name (if the client has several)

tools.name: ovfs_tree
tools.title: Restore tree of a job chain
tools.description: Directory tree below root as JSON, depth levels deep (1 = root and its children). Directories at the depth limit carry 'entries' instead of children; expand them with ovfs_ls. Every node carries jobid/fileindex (restore identity). Keep depth small.

jobids.description: comma-separated JobIds of the chain (Full, Differential, Incrementals); or use client

client.description: client name: the chain of its latest state (restore option 5)

fileset.description: FileSet name, needed if the client has backups of several FileSets

max_entries.description: most nodes in the result, default 100000

tools.name: ovfs_ls
tools.title: List one directory of a job chain
tools.description: Direct children of one directory (files first, then directories with 'entries' counts).

jobids.description: comma-separated JobIds of the chain (Full, Differential, Incrementals); or use client

client.description: client name: the chain of its latest state (restore option 5)

fileset.description: FileSet name, needed if the client has backups of several FileSets

tools.name: ovfs_versions
tools.title: Versions of one file
tools.description: All backed-up versions of a file of a client, newest first, with volumes.

name.description: file name; empty for the directory itself

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs from the catalog
tools.description: Jobs from the catalog (list jobs / llist jobs), newest last. Filters combine. Example: {"client":"bareos-fd","jobstatus":["T","W"],"limit":10}.

job.description: only jobs with this job name

jobstatus.description: job status letter(s) or name(s): T terminated, W warnings, E error, f fatal, A canceled, R running, …

jobtype.description: job type letter(s) or exact name(s): B/Backup, R/Restore, V/Verify, D/Admin, c/Copy, g/Migrate, O/Consolidate, A/Archive

level.description: job level(s): F/Full, I/Incremental, D/Differential, f/VirtualFull, B/Base

volume.description: only jobs that wrote to this volume

days.description: only jobs started in the last n days

hours.description: only jobs started in the last n hours

last.description: only the last run of each job name

count.description: only the number of matching jobs

long.description: true: llist (all fields of every record) instead of list

format.description: json (default): the Director's JSON API result; text: the bconsole text output
